rationale: The proposed topology improves the S11 margin by enhancing input impedance matching through the addition of a series inductor at the input, which resonates with the input capacitance (Cin) to achieve better reflection coefficient performance at the target frequency. This is critical as the current S11 constraint is the most binding (margin = -0.04038), and the narrowband nature of the GPS band allows for precise resonant tuning. The addition of the inductor does not degrade NF, gain, or power, as it is placed in the input path where its impact on noise and gain is minimal when properly sized and integrated with the existing Cin. The topology remains compact and within the device budget, leveraging the allowed inductors.
